# Stall holder segments

Three kinds of seller work the Lisbon farmers markets. Grower-sellers bring their own harvest and own the whole loss. Resellers buy from several growers and carry stock across days. Prepared-food stalls buy fresh produce each morning and need it crisp until the lunch rush.

Grower-sellers feel the cooling gap most, but they also have the smallest budgets. Resellers have the cash and the longest holding times.
